name: native-select
title: Native Select
description: A styled native <select> for mobile-heavy forms, with the same options shape as Select, a placeholder and a clearable none choice. A small primitive reports it to agents, which a bare <select> is not.
docs: `<NativeSelect options placeholder clearable value onValueChange name required>` inside a `Field`: the platform's own picker, which suits touch screens and long lists better than a popup. `options` takes Select's shape (`{ value, label, disabled? }` and groups `{ label, options }`, rendered as `<optgroup>`); values are strings, and `null` means nothing chosen. Native `required` and form submission work as usual. UI SDK ships no part for a native select, and its agent bridge lists only UI SDK parts, so a bare `<select>` or a `FieldControl` is invisible to agents. NativeSelect renders through its own primitive (`native-select`, `closed`) that lists its choices and takes `setValue` by label or value; an unknown choice is refused with the real ones. Inside a `FormField` it binds like Select.
